definitions.explanation: Being released from a hospital after treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I can be discharged next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{退院|たいいん}しました。
examples.english: My father was safely discharged from the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧⟦おめでとうございます→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧。

notes:
{退院|たいいん}する means to be discharged from a hospital after receiving treatment. The noun form ⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧ refers to the discharge itself.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {退院|たいいん}する

FORMS:
{退|たい} (withdraw) + {院|いん} (institution) — literally "leaving the institution."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {退院|たいいん}する: to be discharged
- {退院|たいいん}⟦{後|ご}→後：09580_ato⟧: after discharge
- ⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧⟦{日|び}→〜日：noentry⟧: discharge date
- ⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{退院|たいいん}する: to be safely discharged
- ⟦{退院|たいいん}→退院：02090_taiin⟧⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧: congratulations on leaving the hospital

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧: hospitalization (opposite)
- ⟦{通院|つういん}→通院：05975_tsuuin⟧: visiting hospital as outpatient
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧: hospital

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ to express being allowed to leave: {退院|たいいん}できる (can be discharged). The decision to discharge is made by the doctor.
